full.label: WHOLE PIECE
full.say: Three loops of three, five and six beats start together. They meet in mid-bar at beat 30, and meet on a barline only after sixty beats, on bar 16.
full.decisive: bar 16, beat 1: all three cycles and the barline meet for the first time since the start
